minor.issue: Class-scoped fixture defined as instance method (PytestRemovedIn10Warning) in tests/test_iter222_hardening_http.py (TestApplicationPathRiskUnknown.app_setup) and tests/test_iter221_risk_truth_http.py (TestLiveRiskTruth.live_setup). Behaviour appears correct today but the pattern is deprecated. During my run, 3 TEST_iter222_inv_* programs + 3 associated accounts leaked past teardown (I cleaned them). Root cause is likely tied to this deprecated pattern — teardown may not have executed under class-scoped instance-method fixtures. Recommend converting to @classmethod or module/session-scoped module-level fixtures.
